title: Corless's nilpotent conjecture: proof, Lean formalisation and computations
description:
A proof of Conjecture 5.1 of R. M. Corless (Maple Transactions 1(2), 2021): the recursively constructed vectors give all nilpotent skew-symmetric tridiagonal matrices with superdiagonal entries in {1, i}, and there are exactly 2^(K-1) of them in dimension 2^K - 1. The proof reduces nilpotency modulo 4 to a linear system over F_2.

The record contains the informal proof, a formalisation in Lean 4 with Mathlib in which the main theorems depend only on Lean's standard axioms, and Python and C scripts that check every step numerically and extend the exhaustive verification from m = 31 to m = 63.
